title: Performance uncertainty in medical image analysis: a large-scale investigation of confidence intervals
abstract: arXiv:2601.17103v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Performance uncertainty quantification is essential for reliable validation and eventual clinical translation of medical imaging artificial intelligence (AI). Confidence intervals (CIs) play a central role in this process by indicating how precise a reported performance estimate is. Yet, due to the limited amount of work examining CI behavior in medical imaging, the community remains largely unaware of how many diverse CI methods exist and how they behave in specific settings. The purpose of this study is to close this gap. To this end, we conducted a large-scale empirical analysis across a total of 24 segmentation and classification tasks, using 19 trained models per task group, a broad spectrum of commonly used performance metrics, multiple aggregation strategies, and several widely adopted CI methods. translated_title: 医学图像分析中的性能不确定性：置信区间的大规模研究
translated_abstract: 性能不确定性量化对于医学影像人工智能（AI）的可靠验证及最终临床转化至关重要。置信区间（CIs）在此过程中发挥核心作用，用于指示报告的性能估计的精确程度。然而，由于在医学影像领域对CI行为的研究有限，社区在很大程度上仍不了解存在多少种不同的CI方法以及它们在特定情境下的表现。本研究旨在填补这一空白。为此，我们进行了大规模实证分析，涵盖总共24个分割和分类任务，每个任务组使用19个训练模型，涉及广泛常用的性能指标、多种聚合策略及几种广泛采用的CI方法。我们估算了每种CI方法在所有设置下的可靠性（覆盖率）和精确性（宽度），以表征其依赖性。
tldr: 本研究通过大规模实证分析，系统评估了医学图像分析中多种置信区间方法的可靠性（覆盖率）和精确性（宽度），揭示了其在不同任务、模型和指标下的性能特征，为性能不确定性量化提供了重要参考。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates the reliability (coverage) and precision (width) of various confidence interval methods in medical image analysis across diverse tasks, models, and metrics, providing key insights for performance uncertainty quantification.
